objective: Measure whether a tokenless native binary relational causal substrate can detect a contradiction to an independently observed earlier mechanism, induce a context-conditional intervention relation absent from its initial unary operator catalog, retain old knowledge, and transfer to unseen contexts after matched-action intervention feedback.

source.kind: self-contained deterministic computational binary-action environment; fixture-only
source.prior_nkr10_result: null 106/1270 at4, 8.35%, symbolic tie; do not retune NKR10

mechanism.input: four observed context bits x0..x3, binary public action a
mechanism.old: outcome = parity(x & old_mask) XOR a; old_mask = 1 << (world_id mod 4)
mechanism.new: outcome = parity(x & base_mask) XOR (a AND parity(x & action_interaction_mask)); public environment does NOT announce a mechanism switch
mechanism.unfamiliar_family: old mechanisms had constant action effect, new mechanisms have action/context interactions of 2-4 context bits. All are still within a prespecified parity-feature hypothesis class: no de-novo cognitive operator invention.
mechanism.first_repair_event: x=0,a=1; old outcome is 1 and new outcome is 0 in every world, so contradiction is guaranteed by frozen domain construction (no secret oracle lookup by learner)
mechanism.old_training: for x 0..15, reveal both actions' outcomes; 32 events per world. A warm checkpoint is frozen before any changed-world feedback.
mechanism.new_interventions: eight distinct prespecified contexts; BOTH actions for each, 16 source-revealed intervention outcomes; first event (x=0,a=1) then (x=0,a=0), for subsequent contexts a=0 then a=1; never reveal cold-context outcomes to learner
mechanism.evaluation: cold x in eight untouched contexts, both actions (16 per world, total 192); old checkpoint retention tested on all x0..15, actions 0/1 (32 per world, total 384)
mechanism.feedback: strict canonical source SHA256, unique observation refs, engineering_fixture_only source mode and observed_intervention source kind. No oracle/heldout target visible to learning.

learner.representation: 10-bit GF(2) coefficient signature: bias, four context main effects, global action effect, four action-context interaction effects; exact integer Gaussian elimination; hypotheses only on identifiable predictions; no neural gradient, tokens or transformer
learner.change_detection: first observed post-warm public outcome must CONTRADICT old model before an immutable separate repair checkpoint may start; no access to hidden phase flag or world masks
learner.source_fence: warm and repair records are given only after public action was executed in the controlled environment; raw event SHA proves byte identity, NOT real-world authenticity; native accepted false
learner.retention: old warm checkpoint remains identical and accessible independently after new repair; no interference or mutation of YPC1/accepted DG1 state

controls.strong_active: independently coded exhaustive enumeration over all 1024 binary coefficient signatures, same 16 revealed paired intervention events as native; exact parity-equivalent fully fitted conventional symbolic control EXPECTED TIE
controls.passive: same 16 real outcome observations, two repeats per training context, actions selected by confounded observational policy a=x_bit0; no other action available; unidentifiable predictions abstain (scored incorrect in denominator)
controls.random_action: same training contexts and 16 action budget; two seeded deterministic random actions per context without forcing both arms; no hidden oracle; solve with same 10-feature theory
controls.static_old: no model update after reversal, frozen old checkpoint
controls.instant_reset: explicitly disclosed phase transition plus same 16 paired outcomes, strong oracle-changepoint upper comparator EXPECTED TIE
controls.metric: 192 cold action-outcome queries; total correctly identified exact outcomes divided by all queries (abstain counts 0); coverage separately; old retention 384/384; contradiction 12/12; exact control tie for all candidate outputs; budget and checkpoint SHA/bytes

threshold.development_min_success: native active >=173/192 correct (90.1%); >=38/192 more correct than passive (19.8pp); 384/384 old retention, 12/12 contradiction trigger, zero cold-label exposure and zero accepted-native mutation
threshold.scientific_pass: Never from self-created deterministic fixture or parity-equivalent strong control; ENGINEERING_ONLY. Real independent unfamiliar domains, authentic actions, rival conventional trained baseline and whole-process cost required before scientific promotion.
threshold.null_behavior: Preserve full negative and any tie or lack of intervention lift; do not change seeds, world order, parameter family, split, budgets, controls, threshold or labels after seeing results.

gates.development: Source-free focused and negative controls both Ubuntu/Windows before G29
gates.acceptance: Mandatory full root regression + independent G29 both OS on exact SHA/tree; no full historical 21M artifact reread because these are typed intervention observations and NKR10 already qualified source interface
gates.artifacts: Small CI receipt/prereg & code in repo; no new persistent owner checkpoint or scheduled tasks
